definitions.up_l: tau with masks only at layers before l, the model's own from l on: what upstream masks cost through the activations the change reads
definitions.xclean_l: tau with every mask on, the added term reading the clean forward's input: what the masks at and after the change cost, with the term as in the clean model. The clean forward's inputs include the term's effect inside its own block; first order
definitions.stream_gap: per layer, distance of the masked residual stream from the clean one over the clean one's norm, input of the gate matrix, first 32 rows

factor.rule: rules.factor(tau_up, tau_xclean), per block 0, 7, 14, 21, dW and Gaussian: up at or under 0.1 and xclean above: 'upstream activations'; xclean at or under and up above: 'own and later masks'; both: 'both'; neither: 'neither'.
